Remediation Action: Review effective permissions for privileged and workload roles; remove unjustified grants and document approved exceptions.
Closure Evidence: Approved access review and redacted policy comparison
Validation Criteria: Sampled permissions have business justification; excess grants removed or approved with expiry.

Remediation Action: Enforce required strong authentication and controlled role assumption for privileged human access.
Closure Evidence: Redacted identity configuration and repeat-test record
Validation Criteria: All in-scope privileged human paths meet approved authentication requirements or have approved exceptions.

Remediation Action: Remove unapproved public exposure and restrict ingress to documented business needs.
Closure Evidence: Public endpoint inventory, rule changes and repeat test
Validation Criteria: No unexplained public management/data service; remaining exposures are approved.

Remediation Action: Implement and validate separation between public entry, application, data and administration zones.
Closure Evidence: Updated diagram, rule review and connectivity test
Validation Criteria: Only approved inter-zone paths succeed; prohibited paths fail.

Remediation Action: Validate CloudTrail account/region and event coverage against approved requirements.
Closure Evidence: Coverage matrix and safe test-event trace
Validation Criteria: Required scope is covered and test activity appears in the intended destination.

Remediation Action: Restrict log administration and align protection/retention settings to approved policy.
Closure Evidence: Destination policy, access review and retention configuration
Validation Criteria: Unauthorized alteration/deletion paths removed; retention and protection meet policy.

Remediation Action: Test critical alerts, assign responders and define escalation expectations.
Closure Evidence: Alert test record and response ticket
Validation Criteria: Selected alerts reach accountable responders and response is recorded.

Remediation Action: Enable appropriate configuration recording and establish a drift triage workflow.
Closure Evidence: Recorder coverage, rule history and triage tickets
Validation Criteria: Required resources are recorded; material deviations have owner and disposition.

Remediation Action: Require review and traceability for infrastructure-as-code and cloud changes.
Closure Evidence: Protected workflow settings, approvals and deployment logs
Validation Criteria: Sampled changes show authorization, traceable deployment and post-change validation.

Remediation Action: Validate backup coverage and conduct restoration testing against approved RTO/RPO.
Closure Evidence: Backup report, restore test and business sign-off
Validation Criteria: Critical workloads meet objectives or gaps have approved risk treatment.

Remediation Action: Remove exposed secrets, rotate affected credentials and prefer managed or short-lived credentials.
Closure Evidence: Secret scan and rotation evidence without secret values
Validation Criteria: No active exposed credential remains; access and rotation are validated.

Remediation Action: Assign owners and due dates to material findings; establish escalation and risk-acceptance approval.
Closure Evidence: Updated finding tracker and exception approvals
Validation Criteria: Critical/high findings are owned, tracked and closed with validation or formally accepted.
